doc:posts.rawContent:
Stick with Molten
Use Ace Pilot as your starting tower
Upgrade it to level 1
Farm until Slows show up (those 8 hp zombies) -> upgrade ur ace to bombing
If you farmed correctly, you should have at least 3 level 3 farms at wave 9
Upgrade ace to the level which it changes plane at wave 10
Farm a bit at wave 11
Save money at wave 12
Upgrade ace at wave 13
Farm until you have 8 level 3 farms
Place a DJ and level it up to level 3
Farm until you have 4 maxed farms while also maxing ur ace pilot
Max ur DJ
Place 2 maxed minis
Max all ur farms
Spam mini and chain commanders
Max all farms
